items.title: R.C.H. Smith Interview, 1975-10-02
items.q: Bill Napier, for a short while, right before he went east to join Bob Scobie for one of Scobie's last major trips.

ctx.x: who was in the Ori band.

At the time, I was in the Ori band and we're talking again the 1958 to 60 era. Boy, I'm about to draw a blank on the piano player, which was terrible. Let's see. Well, anyway, the front line was Ori, of course, trombone. I was playing trumpet. The clarinetist was either Bill Shea or Ellis Horn, who had been a veteran of the Lou Waters band. Bill Napier, for a short while, right before he went east to join Bob Scobie for one of Scobie's last major trips. Napier was very good, fit the band very well. And back of…
while I think that. No, we'll come to you.
